ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Century Enka Limited has announced its 60th Annual General Meeting (AGM) for August 20, 2026, along with the declaration of a Rs. 11 per equity share dividend, with August 13, 2026, as the record date. The company is actively notifying shareholders, particularly those without registered email addresses, on how to access the AGM notice and FY 2025-26 Annual Report online, while urging them to update contact and KYC details to ensure seamless future communications and dividend payments. No material red flags are identified; this is a standard regulatory and shareholder communication.
